title: Glitter Till Wednesday
subject: a woman who goes to one Saturday warehouse rave in a glitter top and keeps finding the glitter all through the working week, on her keyboard, in her porridge and on her manager's sleeve during Wednesday's budget meeting
caption: Sleazepop, 2025-26 underground electronic pop style. Distorted 909 kick on four, a rubbery squelching acid 303 bassline, glassy detuned supersaw stabs, crunchy breakbeat fills between sections, a heavy sub bass. Lo-fi club grit with an overdriven mix bus and a dry close vocal. Female alto, deadpan talk-sung verses, breathy then shouted hook. 132 BPM, F minor. Giddy, cheeky and hot-blooded. No trap drums, no autotune warble, no acoustic guitar, no big pop ballad chorus, no festival EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - acid bassline and 909 kick]

[Verse 1]
Saturday, a warehouse in Hackney
Silver top, a size too small
Danced till the lights came on
Washed my hair, no use at all

[Chorus]
Glitter till Wednesday
On my keys, on my phone
Monday at my desk
In the space bar, made a home

[Verse 2]
Tuesday it's in my porridge
Tuesday it's in my tea
Wednesday budget meeting
It's on Gary, next to me

[Pre-Chorus]
He looks down at his sleeve
I look at the floor

[Chorus]
Glitter till Wednesday
On my keys, on his arm
Gary asks me where I've been
I say nowhere, stay calm

[Bridge - breakbeat]
Friday, it's nearly gone
Saturday, top back on

[Outro - acid bassline]
Glitter till Wednesday
See you Saturday
